tmp:3121: ha-niggun, bechinat shir chadash — the melody as aspect of the 'new song' (shir chadash) of the future redemption, the song of wonders/providence
tmp:3122: nittaken ha-rei'ach — the rectification of the sense of smell, the faculty restored through prophecy/rebuke (scent of the souls)
tmp:3125: nifla'ot shelo ke-derekh ha-teva — wonders/miracles beyond the natural order, i.e., conduct by pure Divine providence rather than nature
tmp:3126: yitnaheg ha-olam al yedei nifla'ot — the future state in which the world will be conducted solely through wondrous providence after the renewal of the world
tmp:3127: lehitkarev le-manhig amiti — the act of drawing close/attaching oneself to a true leader (tzaddik), sought through searching and prayer
tmp:3128: she-yizkeh le-emunah amitit bi-shleimut — the goal of meriting true, complete holy faith (emunah), attained via closeness to the true leader
tmp:3129: she-zokheh lehitkarev la-manhig ha-amiti — the merit/state of being drawn close to the true leader, whereby one's imagination and faith are rectified
tmp:3130: nittaken ve-nitbarer etzlo bechinat ha-medammeh — the rectification and clarification of the imaginative faculty (koach ha-medammeh) effected in the follower by the leader's prophetic spirit
tmp:3131: ha-ruach ha-kodesh she-yesh le-ha-manhig ha-amiti — the true leader's measure of holy spirit (ruach ha-kodesh), his 'different spirit' that is an aspect of prophecy
tmp:3132: nitchazek ve-nittaken etzlam ha-emunah ha-amitit di-kedushah — the strengthening and rectification of true holy faith in those who draw near the true leader
tmp:3133: nittaken ha-medammeh — the rectified state of the imaginative faculty, achieved when it is 'in the hand of the prophets' (Hosea 12:11)
tmp:3134: she-nitkabtzin ve-nitrabin beyoter nafshot Yisrael be-yachad — the gathering/aggregation of many Jewish souls together (kibbutz of Israel), which magnifies prayer
tmp:3135: nitrabeh ve-nitgadel beit ha-tefillah — the exceeding enlargement of the 'house of prayer,' prayer magnified by each added Jewish soul/neighbor
tmp:3136: u-khe-she-nislach he-avon — the state following forgiveness of sin, when the darkening cloud is removed and the sun shines to heal
tmp:3137: selichat he-avon — forgiveness of sin, effected by abundance of prayers that disperses the sin-cloud so the healing sun shines
tmp:3138: ha-ananim, ha-Sitra Achra ve-ha-kelipot kalim ve-holkhim — the dissipation of the 'clouds' (the Other Side and husks) through prayer, allowing the glory to be revealed
tmp:3139: zerichat ha-shemesh — the shining/rising of the sun as symbol of the revelation of God's glory that brings healing (Malachi 3:20)
tmp:3141: ha-tefillah shel ha-ba'al koach, bechinat Pinchas — the forceful judgment-prayer of the man of spiritual power (aspect of Pinchas), the 'staff of strength' lodged in the Sitra Achra's throat
tmp:3142: shibbarta rashei taninim al ha-mayim (Ps 74:13) — the breaking of the sea-serpents' heads, i.e., subduing the swallowing Sitra Achra to force it to disgorge holiness
tmp:3143: nikhna bechinat ekev de-Sitra Achra — the subjugation of the 'heel' of the Other Side, its lowest grasp humbled through the rectifying voice
tmp:3144: gedelim sham kol ha-reichot — the garden (watered by the voice/river from Eden) as place where all holy fragrances and fears grow
tmp:3145: ke-she-ha-mokhiach ra'ui lehokhiach — the qualified rebuker: one fit to give rebuke, whose reproof adds fragrance to souls rather than fouling their scent
tmp:3146: mosif ve-noten rei'ach tov be-ha-neshamot — the effect of worthy rebuke (like Moshe's after the Calf) that adds a good scent to the souls ('my nard gave forth its fragrance')
tmp:3147: klei melakhah shel ma'aseh bereishit — the 'tools' of the work of Creation (symbolized by the ten-cubit axe, narga), instruments of the world's fashioning
tmp:3148: mezona de-nishmata — Zoharic term: the 'food of the soul,' the sustenance of the neshamah (fragrance/spiritual nourishment) as opposed to bodily food
tmp:3149: bittul emunot kozviyot ve-tikkun ha-emunah ha-kedoshah — the nullification of false beliefs and rectification of holy faith, effected via the shofar sounds/rectified imagination
tmp:3150: ke-she-ro'eh adam she-bo'er beyoter chutz me-ha-middah — the state of seeing oneself burning with fervor beyond proper measure, the storm-wind over-inflaming the heart (harisah, 'breaking through')
tmp:3151: ve-chozer u-vo'er la-Shem yitbarakh — the heart's renewed, regulated burning toward God after the lung-wind cools its excess fire
tmp:3152: afruriyut — earthiness/dusty sluggishness, the coarse element that dampens the heart's fervor (source of melancholy)
tmp:3153: marah shechorah — black bile/melancholy, the depressive humor that clouds the mind and prevents guiding the brain at will
tmp:3154: liba de-khol alma — Aramaic: the 'heart of the whole world,' the tzaddik/leader who functions as the cosmic heart
tmp:3155: liba — Aramaic 'the heart,' the bodily organ of the Tikkunei Zohar passage that would burn the whole body without the lung-wings' breeze
tmp:3156: manhigei ha-dor — the leaders of the generation, who correspond to the lung-wings cooling the world's heart
tmp:3157: bedichah da'atah — cheerfulness/merriment of mind (Talmudic term), the joyous mental state enabling settled awareness
tmp:3158: lema'lah na'aseh mi-zeh yichud gadol — the great supernal unification (yichud) effected Above by one's joy in his good point/Jewishness
tmp:3160: yishuv ha-da'at — settled mind/composure of thought, the deliberate mental clarity whose lack keeps people far from God
tmp:3161: she-mekasher ha-simchah le-mocho ve-da'ato — the act of binding joy to one's brain and awareness, so that the mind can be governed at will
tmp:3162: she-motzeh be-atzmo eizeh nekudah tovah — finding in oneself some good point (nekudah tovah, per 'azamerah' Torah 282) as the path to joy
tmp:3164: yukhal lehanhig et mocho kirtzono u-leyashev da'ato — the capacity, given by joy (world of freedom), to direct one's brain at will and settle one's mind
tmp:3165: ke-she-mekasher simchah el ha-mo'ach — the condition of joining joy to the brain, the prerequisite state for attaining yishuv ha-da'at
